annotations.title: Change plan, recharge and buy credits

description: What the developer pays Neblla, per PROJECT (projectId, or appId for its project); selling to users is neblla_payments_account. "pro_checkout" (Pro: €10 a month, its own daily credit pool) and "quota_pack_checkout" (one-off credits) only return a URL the developer pays; nothing is granted until Stripe confirms. "cancel_pro": no renewal, Pro lasts to the end of the paid period, no refund; "resume_pro" undoes a pending cancel. "auto_recharge" on buys a pack when the pool runs out, up to monthlyCap, and returns an approveUrl the developer approves in the panel; off applies at once. More: neblla_get_llms tools/billing

action.description: What to do. By action: cancel_pro {charges nothing}; resume_pro {charges nothing, so it needs no approval}; auto_recharge {appId, enabled, monthlyCap}

appId.description: An app: its project; required for auto_recharge.

join.description: pro_checkout: if Pro is full, join the waiting list (default false: only reports its place).

monthlyCap.description: auto_recharge: most it may spend a month, in euros (required to switch on).

projectId.description: The project, from neblla_projects_read list; instead of appId.
